title: New UAP reports to AARO, per annual review period

source.name: Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena
source.publisher: All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO), U.S. Department of Defense

notes: AARO's prior annual report cited 281 new UAP reports for its review period. The following annual report (covering May 2023-June 2024) logged 757 new reports -- 485 from that window plus 272 older 2021-2022 cases not previously forwarded. AARO attributed most of the jump to increased reporting awareness, not more sightings.
